name: zcode-rtl-fixer
description: Persian/English mixed-text (bidi) fixer for the ZCode Desktop chat box: automatic RTL paragraphs, Persian font, RTL tables, RTL list markers; code blocks untouched. Includes installer/patcher, font installer and settings commands.

description_i18n.en: Persian/English mixed-text (bidi) fixer for the ZCode Desktop chat box: automatic RTL paragraphs, Persian font, RTL tables and list markers; code blocks untouched.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 修复 ZCode Desktop 聊天框中波斯语/英语混排（双向文本）的显示问题：段落自动右到左、波斯语友好字体、表格与列表标记右到左；代码块保持不变。
